reference.summary: Added integration tests for the login flow against a real Postgres container, with a fake clock for token expiry; the lockout test exposed an off-by-one that let a sixth attempt through, which was fixed.

decisions.reason: the service depends on Postgres behaviour and sleeping would make the expiry test slow
